# LockTextArea <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

</div>


```blitzbasic
LockTextArea:Void textarea:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textarea` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a text area. |

## Description

Holds back redrawing of a text area while you change a lot of it, which is faster and does not flicker. Call [UnlockTextArea](UnlockTextArea) afterwards.

## Differences

* While a text area is locked it sends no events for the changes you make.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Lock", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 3)
area = CreateTextArea(10, 10, 270, 90, win)
LockTextArea area
For i = 1 To 200
	AddTextAreaText area, "Line " + i + Chr$(13)
Next
UnlockTextArea area
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
